title: Workflow History List Response
description: 200 response body for GET /api/v1/workflows (ADR-0024). Newest-first, cursor-paginated submission history; state/result/failure are always the workflow's current values, read fresh at query time, never a cached snapshot from acceptance.

capability.description: The capability this submission was made to (ADR-0024): persisted at submission time, unlike the workflow's own row, which never carried it before this ADR.

input_text.description: The submitted text, verbatim, bounded to the existing 10,000-character workflow.submit limit.

result.description: Present only when state is COMPLETED. Shape is capability-scoped (ADR-0015), same as workflow_read_response's result.

failure.description: Present only when state is FAILED.

next_before.description: Pass as the `before` query parameter to fetch the next page, newest-first. Present (non-null) only when `entries` reached the requested `limit`, meaning older entries may still exist.
